pal.text:
Colours, as drawn on this canvas (One Dark), proposed for desk-q in 24-bit colour instead of the terminal's 16:

● running / done  green #98C379
◆ needs you  magenta #C678DD
ready  blue #61AFEF
· waiting  yellow #E5C07B
◐ landing  cyan #56B6C2
✕ failed  red #E06C75
◌ blocked, labels  grey #9E9E9E
text #ABB2BF · bold #DCDFE4
